{"app": "word", "action": "write_to_file", "file_path": "/testbed/data/abstract.docx", "contents": "- Introduces the Transformer, a novel architecture that relies solely on attention mechanisms, eliminating recurrence and convolution.
- Uses multi‑head self‑attention to capture global dependencies efficiently.
- Achieves state‑of‑the‑art BLEU scores on WMT 2014 English‑German (28.4) and English‑French (41.0) translation tasks.
- Significantly reduces training time compared to RNN/CNN models (e.g., 12 hours on 8 GPUs for base model).
- Employs positional encodings (sinusoidal) to retain sequence order without recurrence.
- Demonstrates that attention‑only models are more parallelizable and scalable.
- Provides extensive ablation studies showing the impact of attention heads, model size, and dropout.
- Opens avenues for applying attention‑based models to other modalities beyond text."}
